title: Civil Drafter - Junior to Mid Level
content_text:
Civil Drafter – Junior to Mid Level at Martens & Associates Pty Ltd. Hornsby NSW. Full-time permanent. On-site.

About The Role
Talented junior to intermediate level Civil Drafter (AutoCAD 2d) for the Hornsby multidisciplinary engineering office. Suitable for experienced civil drafters and for willing and enthusiastic new or recently qualified drafters, engineers, and engineering students wanting to build their experience.

Projects include property and development drainage assessment; site water quality, quantity and drainage solutions; civil engineering design of earthworks, roads, regrading; flood assessments, remediation and management plans.

Essential:
- Good verbal and written communications skills in English
- Ability to work in a culturally diverse and multi disciplinary team
- Positive and proactive attitude
- Full time Australian work rights (no restricted visa holders)
- Demonstrable high level 2d drafting skills with BricsCAD or AutoCAD

Favourable: previous drafting with large drawing sets in Australian land development; familiar with DA/CC land development process; GIS; Lisp/Python.

How to Apply: through this post, or email careers@martens.com.au with [CivilDrafter260922] and full name in the subject. Provide cover letter, resume, academic transcripts, contactable work referees.
apply_instructions: Apply via Employment Hero post or email careers@martens.com.au with subject [CivilDrafter260922] and full name; attach cover letter, resume, transcripts and referees.
